_about: Catullus in English, translator per title: Robinson Ellis (in the metres of the original, 1871) and Sir Richard Burton with Leonard Smithers (1894), clean Gutenberg. Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives. Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.

catullus-ellis: The Poems and Fragments of Catullus translated in the metres of the original
catullus-burton-smithers: The Carmina of Caius Valerius Catullus
tr. Sir Richard Burton (verse) and Leonard C. Smithers (prose)

catullus-tibullus-pervigilium-loeb: tr. F. W. Cornish (Catullus), J. P. Postgate (Tibullus), J. W. Mackail (Pervigilium)
catullus-cranstoun-1867: The Poems of Valerius Catullus, translated into English verse (Edinburgh, 1867)
catullus-lamb-1821-v1: The Poems of Caius Valerius Catullus translated, with a preface and notes, vol. I (London: John Murray, 1821)
catullus-tibullus-kelly-erotica-1854: Erotica: the Poems of Catullus and Tibullus, the Vigil of Venus, a literal prose translation with notes, with the metrical versions of Lamb and Grainger and others (Bohn, MDCCCLIV)
catullus-nott-1795-v1: The Poems of Caius Valerius Catullus in English verse, with the Latin text revised, vol. I (London: J. Johnson, 1795; Latin facing)
catullus-hart-davies-1879: Catullus translated into English verse (London: Kegan Paul, 1879)
catullus-stuttaford-1912: The Poems of Gaius Valerius Catullus, with notes and a translation (G. Bell, 1912)
